source_title: A Collage Showing 49 Drill Holes Made by NASA’s Curiosity Mars Rover
source_excerpt: Description This collage shows 49 drill holes captured by NASA’s Curiosity Mars rover as of November 2026. Each hole represents a sample collected from rocks on the Martian surface; Curiosity’s drill, located on the end of its robotic arm, drops pulverized rock samples into instruments in its belly that analyze their composition.
